pageDescription: FAS 6x6 Expedition Vehicles – Powerful all-wheel platform for maximum payload and range. Configurations from €320,000.

hero.title: 6x6 Systems
hero.subtitle: Maximum payload and range – the versatile platform for the most demanding expeditions.

overview.description: The 6x6 platform combines enormous payload capacity with outstanding off-road mobility. Three driven axles provide superior traction even in extreme terrain. The extended frame architecture offers space for spacious living cabins, comprehensive supply systems, and heavy equipment – ideal for autonomous long-term expeditions into remote regions.

features.title: Three-Axle Drive
features.description: Permanent all-wheel drive on all three axles with locking differentials for superior traction in extreme terrain.

features.title: Spacious Design
features.description: Extended frame architecture for generous living cabins with full kitchen, bathroom, and sleeping area.

features.title: Autonomy Systems
features.description: Integrated solar, water, and power supply for weeks of independence in remote areas.

features.title: Payload
features.description: Up to 7,000 kg payload for heavy equipment, long-term provisions, and comprehensive expedition gear.

cta.title: Configure Your 6x6
cta.description: Build your perfect 6x6 expedition vehicle – for maximum autonomy and range.
